done:
T1 fixed all five items. Each has llvm commits with lit tests, the source respell verified per site (old spelling on the old binary vs new spelling on the new binary), and a gate plus foil.

(1) `di` now means EI 7 and is parse-only. 13 `di` lines had come back into the sources through lane lifts of decoder output; they were respelled `ei 0` first, with the old pin.

(2) The F5/F4 0x30/0x40 swap is fixed by making (R+)/(-R) a real operand and routing the decoder through the common memory table. All 2,807 post-increment/pre-decrement pseudo lines are respelled, including the 909 swapped stb_dpi/lda_dpi. The 105 'backend mnemonic is swapped' annotations are gone, and the pseudos are deleted.

(3) Printer misnames:
- The direct-address forms (cpda8 xbc -> cp a,(n:16), addda16, andda16, andda8) now decode as real instructions. 189 wrong-register source sites are respelled and the 57 GPR-typed pseudos deleted.
- MUL/DIV register-register, memory and previous-bank forms now name the result register (div xwa,bc etc.). 1,565 lines were respelled in lockstep.
- Legacy aliases no longer take over printing (bitm -> bit, pushm -> pushw ...).

(4) (xde+) and (-xde) are real syntax; (+xde) and (xde-) are hard errors. 23 `.byte` workaround lines were converted. Bank registers such as (xbc3+) are supported.

(5) Added (xrr+D:8)/(xrr+D:16). The 256 sentinel is retired: `lda xwa,(xsp+256)` now assembles to f3 fd 00 01 30. 1,041 sentinel sites respelled +0:8, 136 lda_dri and 6 .byte +256 workarounds became `lda x,(x+256)`, and 92 wsa1 "[llvm-mc cannot encode this]" lines became instructions. A lit test (addressing-modes.s) had pinned the 256 miscompile; it now checks the real encoding.

Neighbouring defects found and fixed:
- The extended-register LD pair was named backwards: `ldw_erp WA,0x30` actually stores WA into RWA3. Renamed to ldto/ldfr_berp/werp; 9,929 lines respelled in lockstep.
- Pre-decrement word INC/DEC was decoded as post-increment.
- `b1 20` (LDA r16) was decoded as a LOAD.
- A dst 0x08 32-bit store-immediate the CPU does not have was being decoded.
- SRI (Xrr) mode 00 was decoded as the d8 form.
- An ambiguous F1 memory-to-memory decode, introduced by my own direct-address routing, is refused again.
- assert_images_assemble.py ignored LLVM_MC.

The pin was promoted twice: da00420dba8d -> 8e188b215251/a67c5632 -> 4867e03232a6/c949d618, the last built from scratch twice with the same sha. The snapshot was updated and old pins kept. TOOLCHAIN_VERSION UPDATE 17 records every step, the numbers, and what is still false. clang had been built on April 19 at no pin; it is now rebuilt at the pin and its C output is unchanged. The two-decoder synthetic sweep (9,984 probes) moved AGREE 2,882 -> 5,956, REG_DIFF 1,247 -> 126, MNEM_DIFF 320 -> 95, ASYM 100 -> 40, with LEN_DIFF 0 throughout. Scratch in disasm-lanes/wave3a-scratch/ (binary copies, logs, stage patches, the April clang copy, baseline C bins) is disposable; everything quoted has a committed summary under notes/wave3a-toolchain-probes/out/.
